body:
Follow-up to task:7d4f91ad548749c8. A proposal card still shows `feature:<id>` (or the bare id) in its `feature` field instead of the feature's title. Find the break in the end-to-end title resolution and fix it at that point; do not add another fallback that leaves the id on screen.

**Required behavior**

- When a proposal creates or changes a task and names a loaded feature, the `feature` value is a link to `/feature/<id>` whose text is the feature's title.
- When the feature is not loaded at first render, the fallback `feature:<id>` changes to its title once the record is found, without losing the href.
- The proposal heading and Approve/Reject behavior stay as they are.

**Tests**

- A Strategy integration test: load a feature, render a run with a task proposal that names it, and assert the title in the feature field.
- Coverage for an unloaded feature that gains its title, in the layer where that replacement happens; a browser helper test only if the frontend watcher is at fault.
- Keep the existing proposal link tests green.

**Scope:** start with the actual Strategy panel and model. Use components or frontend only if the break is in the shared proposal renderer or title watcher.

**Leaves out:** proposal layout changes and other fields, unless milestone or dependsOn fail through the exact same shared path.
title: plan: proposal feature titles
